cases.description: A first message with an outstanding unexpired challenge registers its sender with a full window and spends the challenge.
cases.name: accept-registering-first-message

cases.description: A counter two above the highest shifts the bitmap by two and sets bit 0.
cases.name: accept-counter-advance

cases.description: A counter 64 above the highest clears the window to bit 0 only.
cases.name: accept-counter-advance-beyond-window

cases.description: An unseen counter two below the highest is accepted and sets bit 2.
cases.name: accept-out-of-order-in-window

cases.description: An unseen counter 63 below the highest, the oldest one in the window, is accepted and sets bit 63.
cases.name: accept-window-lower-edge

cases.description: A press exactly 100 ms after the last accepted press or type passes the gap rule.
cases.name: accept-gap-boundary

cases.description: A 65-byte message, one byte under the minimum, is rejected on length alone.
cases.name: reject-too-short

cases.description: Header version 0 is malformed even though the message is sealed correctly with it.
cases.name: reject-version-zero

cases.description: Header version 2 is too new even though the message is sealed correctly with it, and the plugin names its highest version.
cases.name: reject-version-too-new

cases.description: A message with the plugin-to-phone direction byte is refused although its device id is valid.
cases.name: reject-wrong-direction

cases.description: A message naming a device id the plugin does not hold is refused before any key is used.
cases.name: reject-unknown-device

cases.description: Flipping one bit of the tag makes the AEAD open fail.
cases.name: reject-tampered-tag

cases.description: Flipping one bit of the sender id in the header makes the AEAD open fail, since the header is the associated data.
cases.name: reject-tampered-header

cases.description: A message sealed under another key fails the AEAD open although its header names the right device.
cases.name: reject-wrong-key

cases.description: An authentic message whose body is not JSON gets a sealed bad_body before the window is touched.
cases.name: reject-body-not-json

cases.description: An authentic message whose body is a JSON array gets a sealed bad_body before the window is touched.
cases.name: reject-body-not-object

cases.description: The first message of an unregistered sender without a challenge field is refused and no outstanding challenge is used.
cases.name: reject-unknown-sender-no-challenge

cases.description: A well-formed challenge that is not outstanding, such as a spent one, is refused.
cases.name: reject-challenge-spent

cases.description: A challenge whose expiry equals the current time is expired and is refused, and it stays in the table.
cases.name: reject-challenge-expired

cases.description: A counter equal to the highest seen is a replay.
cases.name: reject-replay-equal-highest

cases.description: A counter inside the window whose bit is already set is a replay.
cases.name: reject-replay-seen-in-window

cases.description: A counter 64 below the highest has fallen out of the window and is too old.
cases.name: reject-counter-below-window

cases.description: A type that the protocol does not define is refused with unknown_type.
cases.name: reject-unknown-type

cases.description: A press without mods is a malformed body.
cases.name: reject-body-missing-field

cases.description: A move with an extra field is a malformed body.
cases.name: reject-body-extra-field

cases.description: A type message whose text contains a line feed is a malformed body.
cases.name: reject-body-text-newline

cases.description: A type message whose submit is a string instead of a boolean is a malformed body.
cases.name: reject-body-type-submit-not-bool

cases.description: A move with dx 1001 is outside the allowed range of plus or minus 1000.
cases.name: reject-body-move-range

cases.description: A press with key 3 is below the lowest keyboard usage 4 and is a malformed body.
cases.name: reject-body-press-key-range

cases.description: A press whose key is a modifier usage (0xE1) is refused as unsupported_key.
cases.name: reject-unsupported-key

cases.description: A type message whose open key is a modifier usage (0xE1) is refused as unsupported_key.
cases.name: reject-unsupported-key-in-open

cases.description: A press 40 ms after the last accepted press or type is refused with retryAfterMs 60, and the counter is still spent.
cases.name: reject-rate-limited

cases.description: A sealed ok that names the outstanding request is delivered and the request is cleared.
cases.name: phone-accept-ok

cases.description: A sealed ok that names a counter the phone is not waiting for is dropped and changes nothing.
cases.name: phone-drop-not-outstanding

cases.description: A correctly sealed ok with the phone-to-plugin direction byte is dropped at the direction check.
cases.name: phone-drop-wrong-direction
